title: Wall Mount Tumbler Toothbrush Holder 5-Inch Projection Solid Brass, Mambo Collection | Lavender | Allied Brass
description:

Designed for the Mambo collection, it fits transitional bathroom hardware plans and pairs easily with versatile bath accessories.

- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
